source: independent (non-author) pred-scout-coach-critic reviewing data/postgame/*.json coaching against the match facts; preference-based / ungrounded lines flagged; grounded rewrites applied back

df3bb8df-14b3-4939-9a59-5cd70cfe8409.quote: We opened well: Khaimera and Drongo caught Aurora and Maco 2-0 at the Fangtooth at 6.7 to secure our only major of the first ten minutes, and won another skirmish at 9.4. Neither got turned into a tower or a camp, while they cashed four of their five fight wins. The break came at 17.3: all five of us engaged a teamfight at our Outer Tower and lost it 2-5, and their Fangtooth fell a minute later. From there it cascaded - three more of their majors fell with several of us already dead going in, and we gave up an Inner Tower, the Inhibitor and the Core before the 27-minute mark. River was theirs most of the game (19 takes to our 5), and the team never built an answer to Maco's healing or the three magical damage sources on their side.
df3bb8df-14b3-4939-9a59-5cd70cfe8409.issue: three numeric errors vs SOURCE (we took two majors in the first 10 min, not one; only two more of their majors fell after 17.3, not three; two Inner Towers fell, not one, and Core fell at 27.2m, not before 27m)
df3bb8df-14b3-4939-9a59-5cd70cfe8409.rewrite: We opened well: Khaimera and Drongo caught Aurora and Maco 2-0 at the Fangtooth at 6.7, one of two majors we took in the first ten minutes (the other a Seedling at 7), and won another skirmish at 9.4. Neither got turned into a tower or a camp, while they cashed four of their five fight wins. The break came at 17.3: all five of us engaged a teamfight at our Outer Tower and lost it 2-5, and their Fangtooth fell a minute later. From there it cascaded - their Primal Fangtooth fell at 24 with several of us already dead going in, and we gave up two Inner Towers, the Inhibitor and the Core by 27 minutes. River was theirs most of the game (19 takes to our 5), and the team never built an answer to Maco's healing or the three magical damage sources on their side.
